messages:
maria: FYI follow-up from the latency postmortem - we need concrete owners and due dates for SLO/SLA updates + dashboard changes. recurring pattern on long-tail p95 spikes around prefix 'embed-'

devin: agree. saw burn in error budget last 48h ~4.2% above target, mostly during small traffic bursts. https://metrics.redwood.internal/errbudget/embed-p95 :thinking_face:

lucy: can we get a short list of actionables? I can take dashboard work but need exact queries + alert thresholds.

tanvi: I'll own remediation for the batching misconfig that surfaced. plan: change max_batch_latency from 200ms -> 120ms in canary, monitor 24h, rollback if throughput drops >7%. target: canary by EOD Thu, full rollout next Tue.

maria: assigning: tanvi -> batching config + canary; lucy -> dashboard + alerts; devin -> SLO update proposal + runbook edits. I'll coordinate comms with product.

devin: proposed SLO tweak: current SLO p95 <250ms @99.5. propose split by route: /generate p95 250ms @99.5, /embed p95 180ms @99.0 (embed is bursty). will open PR tomorrow.

lucy: dashboard plan: add per-prefix p50/p95/p99, and a 'burstiness' panel (rolling stddev of QPS). alerts:
- Warning: p95 > 220ms for 10m (ops slack)
- Critical: p95 > 300ms for 5m (pager)
I'll add queries and link to runbook.

maria: error budget note: embed route burned ~2.1% of monthly budget this week alone. if we don't cap burstiness or adjust routing, we'll hit SLA. consider fallback to smaller model during peak.

tanvi: adding fallback: route to embed-small when queue_length > 100 and p95 > 250ms. will implement in routing rules and test in canary.

devin: PR checklist for SLO change: 1) SLO doc update + motivation 2) Dashboard adjustments 3) Customer impact email 4) Meeting w/ support. aiming to ship Fri.

ops-bot: incident-17823 closed by tanvi. tags: latency, embed-route.

lucy: can someone share the synthetic test that reproduces short burst? want to add to CI.

maria: @devin created load-test script infra/tests/latency/burst_embed_test.sh. devin, paste command?

devin: `./burst_embed_test.sh --qps 120 --burst 60s --payload-size 4kb` will reproduce. I'll add nightly job for embed route.

maria: recap of action items:
- tanvi: implement max_batch_latency change + fallback routing, canary by EOD Thu, full rollout Tue
- lucy: dashboard panels + alerts + runbook links, by Mon noon
- devin: SLO doc PR + add synthetic nightly job, PR by Fri
- maria: customer comms + SLA impact review, by Fri COB
please ack and update your PRs in the postmortem board. I'll tick off items in next weekly SLO sync. :white_check_mark:

lucy: acked. starting dashboard edits.

tanvi: acked. will post canary results here.

devin: acked.
